body: ## Pull request overview This PR addresses a Windows-only crash in the spiral fitter caused by `np.random.RandomState.randint` defaulting to a 32-bit C long on Windows, which cannot accept `high` bounds that require `int64`. The fix targets the non-prefetch (legacy) RNG adapter and the prefetch seeding path so Windows users can start optimization without immediately failing. **Changes:** - Update `LegacyNumpyRandom.randint` to request `int64` results when drawing large-range integers from the global `np.random` stream. - Update `StepPrefetcher.np_rng` seeding to explicitly request an `int64` draw to avoid Windows overflow errors during prefetch RNG initialization. --- 💡 Add a `code-review` agent skill or configure MCP servers for context-aware, tailored reviews. Learn more in the docs.
